verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a developer API (fastmail.com/dev) built on the open JMAP standard, with standard OAuth 2.0/Bearer auth, API tokens, and batched methodCalls over HTTP, so developers can build against it directly. However, nothing in the evidence shows an official, first-party SDK or client library. Probes for an OpenAPI spec also returned 404, so users must hand-roll JMAP HTTP calls. Missing for 10: any evidence of official SDKs/client libraries in specific languages, SDK documentation or examples, a machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration of developer experience.
